errors.text: The hypothesis predicts a decreasing HCP atom count above 900 K, whereas the target reports that the HCP atom fraction increases with temperature. This reverses the key structural diagnostic.
It upgrades rapid lattice disorder into full amorphization and attributes it to a specific Shockley-partial annihilation cascade without direct evidence from the target or cited sources.
The proposed simulations lack thermal-only and mechanically unloaded controls, so they cannot cleanly distinguish thermally induced disorder from indentation-driven mechanical annealing.
